findings: V015 preserves a broad dark center for the existing SGDK and FORGE lockup and retains the blue crystalline material.
The upper-left remains the dominant crystal mass; the upper-right is quieter and the strongest right-side cluster is lower, giving the perimeter a clearer asymmetry.
The bottom-center flare is smaller than in the registered reference but the horizontal reflection remains visible and needs another composition review.
This 1500x1049 RGB image is concept art, not native Mega Drive pixel art. Do not use it as a runtime asset or infer 320x224 readability from its source-size appearance.

game_design_context.gameplay_role: Four-second front-end brand reveal before the menu; the lab preview can replay on A after the hold.
interaction_context: No world navigation or gameplay interaction occurs during the reveal.
The 240-frame sequence builds a crystal energy field, converges into the SGDK/FORGE lockup, sweeps, holds, and fades.
The lab preview displays A: REVER after the hold; the handoff profile transitions to the menu after fade and DMA drain.

must_preserve.expected: Keep a broad dark central field free of high-contrast crystal detail so SGDK and FORGE remain dominant.
Use angular, varied crystal clusters around the perimeter with directional inward energy; avoid a symmetric static ring.
Midnight navy, cobalt, cyan and ice-blue highlights with sparse near-white points; retain clear value separation.
Faceted hard-edged crystal shapes read as discrete forms at 320x224 rather than continuous haze, gradients or noise.

secondary_motion: Edge shards and short streaks imply inward movement; runtime particles provide the staged motion.
expression_requirements: Discovery and energetic anticipation; short accents instead of a sustained glow wash.
state_fantasy_checks: The logo reveal feels like a premium technology boot sequence.
SGDK stays primary and FORGE remains secondary through reveal, sweep, and hold.

background_scene_context.depth_role_map: BG_B carries the energy field; BG_A carries separately authored SGDK/FORGE plates; sprites provide converging particles and the brief sweep.
background_scene_context.layer_plan: Keep high-contrast detail at the perimeter, protect the center, and preserve the existing single-screen 320x224 H40 composition.
background_scene_context.sprite_readability_policy: Backdrop crystal facets must not camouflage the 8x8 particle silhouettes or the lettering plates.
